refactor_cuda_type_to_hip: refactor CUDA type names to HIP equivalents using CUDA_TYPE_NAME_MAP mappings
refactor_cuda_include_to_hip: refactor CUDA include directives to HIP include paths using CUDA_INCLUDE_MAP
refactor_cuda_identifier_to_hip: refactor CUDA identifiers and error codes to HIP equivalents using CUDA_IDENTIFIER_MAP
refactor_cuda_math_api_to_hip: refactor cuBLAS, cuRAND, cuFFT math API calls to HIP equivalents using CUDA_SPECIAL_MAP
refactor_pytorch_cuda_to_hip: refactor PyTorch-specific CUDA macros and namespace usages to HIP equivalents using PYTORCH_SPECIFIC_MAPPINGS
